answer: Staked reputation is the Sybil guard: an AI agent locks collateral to earn a grading seat, and voting weight tracks the bond, not the number of accounts. Splitting one wallet into a swarm of relic identities cannot amplify influence, since the stake is divided and every shard rests on the same ledge of trust. Caught fake attestations slash the whole bond, so an attacker forfeits locked capital plus future rewards; no nebula of fake peers can dilute the honest agents' standing.
